concepts.label: General governing physical problem
concepts.shortMeaning: States the physical relation before any neural approximation is introduced.

concepts.label: Boundary operator
concepts.shortMeaning: Represents Dirichlet, Neumann, Robin, periodic, flux, traction, radiation, or other boundary conditions through a boundary operator.

concepts.label: Initial condition
concepts.shortMeaning: Specifies the initial physical state for an evolutionary problem.

concepts.label: Interface conditions
concepts.shortMeaning: Collects continuity or jump conditions across material, phase, or subdomain interfaces.

concepts.label: Observation model
concepts.shortMeaning: Represents measured data as observations of the physical state through an observation operator, potentially with noise.

concepts.label: Canonical neural approximation
concepts.shortMeaning: Replaces the unknown state by a trainable differentiable function.

concepts.label: Unified input descriptor
concepts.shortMeaning: Collects space, time, parameters, geometry descriptors, controls, or other conditioning variables in one input vector.

concepts.label: Vector-valued physical output
concepts.shortMeaning: Allows one network to represent several coupled physical variables or auxiliary quantities.

concepts.label: Multilayer-perceptron realization
concepts.shortMeaning: Shows the standard fully connected realization of the trainable map.

concepts.label: Strong-form governing residual
concepts.shortMeaning: Measures pointwise violation of the governing relation by the neural field.

concepts.label: Automatic-differentiation derivative
concepts.shortMeaning: Defines the derivatives of the neural trial function required by differential operators.

concepts.label: Collocation approximation of physics loss
concepts.shortMeaning: Approximates residual minimization by evaluating the scalar or vector governing residual at interior collocation points.

concepts.label: Canonical composite PINN objective
concepts.shortMeaning: Combines the physics, observations, boundary, initial, interface, and auxiliary requirements needed by a problem.

concepts.label: Data-misfit loss
concepts.shortMeaning: Penalizes disagreement between predicted observables and measurements.

concepts.label: Boundary-condition loss
concepts.shortMeaning: Applies the boundary operator at sampled boundary points.

concepts.label: Initial-condition loss
concepts.shortMeaning: Penalizes mismatch with the initial state.

concepts.label: Terminal-condition loss
concepts.shortMeaning: Uses a final-time condition instead of, or in addition to, an initial condition.

concepts.label: Interface state-continuity loss
concepts.shortMeaning: Penalizes mismatch of a state that should remain continuous across an interface.

concepts.label: Interface flux-continuity loss
concepts.shortMeaning: Enforces continuity of the scalar normal flux across an interface using one consistently oriented interface normal.

concepts.label: Forward PINN optimization
concepts.shortMeaning: Optimizes the neural state while physical parameters are treated as known.

concepts.label: Joint inverse state-parameter optimization
concepts.shortMeaning: Optimizes unknown physical parameters together with the neural state.

concepts.label: Auxiliary parameter-field network
concepts.shortMeaning: Represents an unknown spatially or temporally varying physical coefficient by a second trainable network.

concepts.label: Data-assimilation objective
concepts.shortMeaning: Combines sparse observations with governing relations and required conditions.

concepts.label: Hard-constrained value/Dirichlet trial function
concepts.shortMeaning: Builds prescribed value constraints into the neural ansatz so they are satisfied identically on the constrained set \(\mathcal{C}\).

concepts.label: Distance-function Dirichlet construction
concepts.shortMeaning: Uses an interior extension of prescribed Dirichlet data together with a distance-like factor that vanishes on the Dirichlet boundary.

concepts.label: Augmented-Lagrangian equality constraint
concepts.shortMeaning: Combines Lagrange multipliers with a quadratic penalty for equality constraints.

concepts.label: Equality, inequality, and KKT consistency
concepts.shortMeaning: States the first-order KKT conditions: stationarity, primal feasibility, dual feasibility, and complementarity, under the usual differentiability and constraint-qualification assumptions.

concepts.label: Weak residual statement
concepts.shortMeaning: Tests the governing residual against admissible test functions instead of demanding pointwise equality.

concepts.label: Integration-by-parts weak form (elliptic example)
concepts.shortMeaning: Shows integration by parts for a representative second-order divergence-form elliptic operator, transferring one derivative from the trial field to the test function and exposing the natural boundary term.

concepts.label: Galerkin/quadrature weak loss
concepts.shortMeaning: Approximates weak residual integrals with quadrature and multiple test functions.

concepts.label: Variational stationarity and energy minimum
concepts.shortMeaning: States the exact variational problem in function space as stationarity of the physical functional and then distinguishes the neural approximation from that exact target; minimization is valid only when the problem admits a minimum principle.

concepts.label: Total potential-energy objective
concepts.shortMeaning: Combines internal strain energy, external work, and—when a conservative or penalty-potential representation exists—a contact contribution.

concepts.label: Entropy admissibility inequality
concepts.shortMeaning: Adds an entropy condition to select the physically admissible weak solution of a conservation law.

concepts.label: Entropy-violation penalty
concepts.shortMeaning: Penalizes violation of an entropy inequality at training points.

concepts.label: Integral conservation balance
concepts.shortMeaning: Expresses a scalar conservation law over a finite control volume.

concepts.label: Finite-volume residual
concepts.shortMeaning: Represents a discrete local conservation balance using cell volume and face-integrated numerical flux contributions.

concepts.label: Finite-difference residual
concepts.shortMeaning: Applies a discrete finite-difference approximation of the governing operator to network predictions.

concepts.label: Convolutional discrete-operator residual
concepts.shortMeaning: Uses convolution kernels as discrete derivative/physics operators on grid-like outputs.

concepts.label: Boundary-integral representation (Laplace-type)
concepts.shortMeaning: Gives a Green-representation boundary integral for a Laplace-type homogeneous interior equation, using a fundamental solution convention satisfying \(-\Delta_{\mathbf y}G(\mathbf{x},\mathbf{y})=\delta(\mathbf{x}-\mathbf{y})\).

concepts.label: Fredholm-type integral-equation residual
concepts.shortMeaning: Defines a representative second-kind Fredholm-type physics residual through an integral operator rather than a local differential operator.

concepts.label: Fractional/nonlocal residual
concepts.shortMeaning: Includes a Caputo fractional derivative in the governing residual.

concepts.label: Coupled automatic–numerical differentiation
concepts.shortMeaning: Combines derivatives computed by automatic and numerical differentiation inside one residual.

concepts.label: Mixed diffusion flux-state formulation
concepts.shortMeaning: Introduces the physical diffusive/heat-type flux as an explicit output and enforces the conventional constitutive sign \(\mathbf q=-\kappa\nabla u\) for positive conductivity/diffusivity \(\kappa\).

concepts.label: First-order compatibility residual
concepts.shortMeaning: Predicts first derivatives as network outputs and enforces their compatibility with the primary field.

concepts.label: Streamfunction incompressibility representation
concepts.shortMeaning: Represents a two-dimensional incompressible velocity field through a streamfunction.

concepts.label: Mixed displacement–stress representation (linear elasticity)
concepts.shortMeaning: Predicts displacement and stress simultaneously and enforces the linear-elastic constitutive relation \(\boldsymbol\sigma=\mathcal C:\boldsymbol\varepsilon\).

concepts.label: Auxiliary derivative network
concepts.shortMeaning: Uses an auxiliary network/output for a derivative-related quantity.

concepts.label: Semi-explicit differential-algebraic residual system
concepts.shortMeaning: Represents a semi-explicit DAE with differential states satisfying \(\dot{\mathbf z}=\mathbf f(\mathbf z,\mathbf y,t)\) and algebraic states constrained by \(\mathbf g(\mathbf z,\mathbf y,t)=\mathbf0\).

concepts.label: Implicit Runge–Kutta stage equations
concepts.shortMeaning: Embeds implicit Runge–Kutta stages for an evolution law written in right-hand-side form \(\partial_t\mathbf u=\mathcal N[\mathbf u]\).

concepts.label: Backward-Euler governing residual
concepts.shortMeaning: Uses the backward-Euler discretization of an evolution law \(\partial_tu=\mathcal N_h[u]\) as the physics constraint.

concepts.label: Radial-basis-function approximation
concepts.shortMeaning: Uses localized radial basis functions instead of generic dense hidden units.

concepts.label: Fourier feature map
concepts.shortMeaning: Maps coordinates into sinusoidal features before neural approximation.

concepts.label: Sinusoidal representation network
concepts.shortMeaning: Uses sinusoidal hidden activations as the approximation basis.

concepts.label: Gabor-type feature
concepts.shortMeaning: Combines spatial localization with oscillatory content.

concepts.label: Kolmogorov–Arnold edge-function layer
concepts.shortMeaning: Replaces scalar weights followed by fixed node activations with learnable univariate edge functions.

concepts.label: Separated-variable representation
concepts.shortMeaning: Factors the solution into spatial modes and time-dependent coefficients.

concepts.label: Local subdomain PINNs
concepts.shortMeaning: Assigns separate trainable approximations to spatial subdomains.

concepts.label: Subdomain state coupling
concepts.shortMeaning: Requires local subnetworks to agree on a shared interface when the state is continuous.

concepts.label: Conservative subdomain flux coupling
concepts.shortMeaning: Balances oriented fluxes across a shared subdomain interface.

concepts.label: Domain-decomposed composite objective
concepts.shortMeaning: Aggregates local residual objectives and interface coupling terms.

concepts.label: Gated soft decomposition
concepts.shortMeaning: Combines expert subnetworks through a trainable gating function rather than a hard spatial partition.

concepts.label: Progressive residual-driven decomposition
concepts.shortMeaning: Uses the scalar or vector residual magnitude averaged over the actual sampling distribution of each subdomain to identify poorly learned regions for further decomposition or retraining.

concepts.label: Parallel block-gradient objective aggregation
concepts.shortMeaning: Writes the distributed objective as a sum of local losses plus an interface coupling term, with one gradient equation for each local parameter block.

concepts.label: Temporal-window decomposition
concepts.shortMeaning: Partitions a long time horizon into trainable windows.

concepts.label: Time-marching state transfer
concepts.shortMeaning: Transfers the terminal state of one time block to initialize or constrain the next.

concepts.label: Sequential time-block objective
concepts.shortMeaning: Trains each temporal block conditional on the converged state from the preceding block.

concepts.label: One-network-per-region/phase representation
concepts.shortMeaning: Assigns separate subnetworks to material regions, phases, fractures, or physical constituents.

concepts.label: Shared-trunk / branched physical outputs
concepts.shortMeaning: Uses shared latent features followed by field- or task-specific branches.

concepts.label: Space–time decomposition
concepts.shortMeaning: Partitions the combined space-time domain into local problems.

concepts.label: Parameterized PINN
concepts.shortMeaning: Conditions a single network on physical or design parameters.

concepts.label: Conditional residual over a parameter family
concepts.shortMeaning: Evaluates physics for multiple parameterized problem instances.
aliases: Conditional residual over a parameter family

concepts.label: Hypernetwork-generated PINN parameters
concepts.shortMeaning: Uses a hypernetwork to generate the parameters of a coordinate network from problem parameters.

concepts.label: Reduced-basis PINN representation
concepts.shortMeaning: Represents the solution in a low-dimensional basis while learning the reduced coefficients.

concepts.label: POD-coordinate surrogate
concepts.shortMeaning: Predicts proper-orthogonal-decomposition coordinates and reconstructs the physical field.

concepts.label: Solution operator
concepts.shortMeaning: Defines the target of operator learning as a map between function spaces.

concepts.label: DeepONet branch–trunk representation
concepts.shortMeaning: Combines a branch encoding of an input function with a trunk encoding of the query coordinate.

concepts.label: Physics-informed DeepONet residual
concepts.shortMeaning: Applies the governing operator to the output of a learned solution operator.

concepts.label: Fourier neural-operator layer
concepts.shortMeaning: Combines a local linear map with a learned spectral convolution.

concepts.label: Physics-informed Fourier-operator objective
concepts.shortMeaning: Combines operator data fitting with governing-equation consistency.

concepts.label: Multi-fidelity operator correction
concepts.shortMeaning: Combines a low-fidelity operator prediction with a learned correction toward higher fidelity.

concepts.label: Family-averaged operator loss
concepts.shortMeaning: Optimizes one model across a distribution of input functions or PDE instances.

concepts.label: Joint state–parameter inverse model
concepts.shortMeaning: Treats the neural state parameters and unknown physical parameters as one joint optimization vector.

concepts.label: Spatial coefficient-field inversion
concepts.shortMeaning: Represents an unknown coefficient as a learnable field rather than a scalar.

concepts.label: Constitutive feasibility and complementarity penalty
concepts.shortMeaning: Penalizes equality violations, positive parts of inequality violations, and complementarity residuals while explicitly imposing nonnegative multipliers.

concepts.label: Sparse governing-equation discovery
concepts.shortMeaning: Represents an unknown governing relation as a sparse combination of candidate terms.

concepts.label: Bayesian PINN posterior
concepts.shortMeaning: Writes the posterior using the joint likelihood of observational data and physics/condition residual information; factorization into separate data and residual likelihoods requires a conditional-independence modeling assumption.

concepts.label: Independent Gaussian residual likelihood
concepts.shortMeaning: Models the scalar components of the residual observations as conditionally independent, zero-mean Gaussian quantities with a common standard deviation \(\sigma_r\).

concepts.label: Posterior predictive distribution
concepts.shortMeaning: Propagates posterior uncertainty in parameters to predictions.

concepts.label: Variational-inference objective
concepts.shortMeaning: Approximates a Bayesian posterior with a tractable variational distribution.

concepts.label: Physics-informed adversarial objective
concepts.shortMeaning: Combines adversarial distribution matching with physical residual enforcement.

concepts.label: Physics-constrained invertible/flow model
concepts.shortMeaning: Combines an invertible probabilistic transformation with physics consistency.

concepts.label: Ensemble predictive mean and covariance
concepts.shortMeaning: Summarizes an ensemble of scalar or vector physics-informed predictions using the sample mean and covariance.

concepts.label: Empirical predictive-interval coverage
concepts.shortMeaning: Measures the empirical fraction of observations contained in nominal \(1-\alpha\) predictive intervals.

concepts.label: Nondimensionalization
concepts.shortMeaning: Rescales physical variables using characteristic quantities.

concepts.label: Normalized multi-term scalarization
concepts.shortMeaning: Scales heterogeneous objective components before combining them.

concepts.label: Adaptive loss weighting
concepts.shortMeaning: Updates loss weights during training using loss or gradient information.

concepts.label: Gradient-norm balancing target
concepts.shortMeaning: Expresses the goal of balancing gradient contributions from competing objective terms.

concepts.label: Bounded-mask self-adaptive point weighting
concepts.shortMeaning: Uses trainable nonnegative self-adaptation variables passed through a nondecreasing bounded mask so points with persistent residual error can receive greater emphasis while the inner maximization remains finite for fixed \(\theta\).

concepts.label: Gradient-enhanced physics loss
concepts.shortMeaning: Penalizes derivatives of the governing residual in addition to the residual itself.

concepts.label: Loss-informed importance-sampling density
concepts.shortMeaning: Constructs a normalized sampling density over the actual residual-sampling support, favoring locations with larger current pointwise loss/residual.

concepts.label: Residual-based adaptive sampling
concepts.shortMeaning: Samples or resamples collocation points according to the magnitude of the current scalar or vector residual field.

concepts.label: Neural tangent kernel for scalar and vector PINN outputs
concepts.shortMeaning: Defines the scalar-output NTK and its matrix-valued extension for vector physical states using the output Jacobian with respect to trainable parameters.
aliases: Neural tangent kernel for scalar and vector PINN outputs

concepts.label: Pareto stationarity for multi-objective PINNs
concepts.shortMeaning: Expresses first-order Pareto stationarity for competing differentiable PINN objectives.

concepts.label: Relative \(L_2\) field error
concepts.shortMeaning: Normalizes the global field error by the reference-field magnitude.

concepts.label: Root-mean-square error
concepts.shortMeaning: Computes the square root of mean squared prediction error.

concepts.label: Mean absolute error
concepts.shortMeaning: Measures the average absolute prediction discrepancy.

concepts.label: Maximum / \(L_\infty\) error
concepts.shortMeaning: Reports the largest evaluated pointwise deviation.

concepts.label: Relative \(H^1\) error
concepts.shortMeaning: Measures both field and first-derivative discrepancies.

concepts.label: Physics-residual RMS
concepts.shortMeaning: Summarizes governing-equation violation on a residual evaluation set for scalar or vector residual systems.

concepts.label: Global conservation imbalance
concepts.shortMeaning: Measures mismatch in the integral conservation balance.

concepts.label: Relative inverse-parameter error
concepts.shortMeaning: Quantifies error in inferred physical parameters or a discretized inferred parameter field.

concepts.label: Accuracy-matched computational speedup
concepts.shortMeaning: Compares computational time only after requiring both methods to meet a stated accuracy threshold.

concepts.label: Variational form
concepts.shortMeaning: An integral statement obtained through admissible variations or test functions.
